responsibility: This header declares the entry point for parser pass 3 in the mc front end. It exports the CompilationUnit routine that performs the declaration-building pass covering imports, types, variables, and procedure headers on the buffered token stream.
same_name_distinction: This .h file just declares mcp3_CompilationUnit for the third parser pass. Unlike the same-stem .cc file, it does not include the generated grammar machinery, stack-based state, or declaration-resolution actions used in pass 3.
